jobInfo.jobTitle: Extended Day Program Senior & Junior Aide & Substitutes
jobInfo.jobDescription:
Thank you for considering employment in the Lunenburg Public Schools.

GENERAL

Extended Day Program Senior & Junior Aide Substitutes sought for the afternoon and/or morning session.

The number of days/hours worked will be subject to student participation numbers.

This position is funded through the program revolving funds.

Hiring will be ongoing, as needed, throughout the 2025-2026 school year.

Experience is preferred, but willing to train.

Hourly rates: under 18 years old - $16.31 per hour, over 18 years old between $16.92 per hour

Hiring is subject to satisfactory CORI and SAFIS Background Checks per 603 CMR 51.
